vb_textbox.text: Hello!The most important thing to note is that gnomes appear in pairs. Clicking on the orange, green, red or blue gnomes (which I'll call the bright gnomes) will lead you to a bright forest, while clicking on the brown, pink, yellow or purple gnomes (which I'll call the dark gnomes) will lead you to a dark forest. Something I observed was that if any gnome from the bright group starts producing high numbers, stay on that particular group until it starts decreasing before you switch to the dark group of gnomes' and vice versa.
